the startup sweep warns that it removed nothing when the worktree registry cannot be read
pins: createWorktree removes a stale worktree directory git still has registered
acceptance: One registry probe in src/worktrees.ts, reached by both entry points, reporting whether the read succeeded; an occupied path git disclaims survives and provisioning fails.
notes: Repro: seed `<wtBase>/build/` with a file, call createWorktree('build', HEAD) — `worktree remove --force` fails ('not a working tree'), removeWorktree's blind rm fallback deletes the tree, provisioning succeeds. sweepStaleWorktrees refuses exactly this, keyed on `git worktree list --porcelain`. Cost: an orphan whose registration was already pruned now needs operator action instead of silent recovery — the trade the sweep already took. Probe success is a reported fact, not an empty set.
